text:
The drink that comes from cows is milk.

The text provides clear historical context indicating it originates from the era of Prohibition in the United States. The mention of the "ratification of the 18th Amendment" is the key clue. The 18th Amendment, which prohibited the manufacture, sale, and transportation of intoxicating liquors, was ratified on January 16, 1919, and went into effect on January 17, 1920. Therefore, the pamphlet and the associated text date to the period between 1919 and 1933, when Prohibition was in effect in the U.S.
